ACCOUNT_SETTINGS_DESC: Manage your personal preferences and account-level controls.
ACCOUNT_PAGE_WORKSPACES_DESC: Open your personal workspace and manage team workspaces from one place.
ACCOUNT_PAGE_BILLING_DESC: Review subscription details, invoices, and payment settings for your account.
ACCOUNT_BILLING_SCOPE_TITLE: Billing is owned by the account
ACCOUNT_BILLING_SCOPE_DESC: Workspace activity rolls up here. You no longer need a separate organization console to understand who pays for what.
ACCOUNT_BILLING_SURFACE_DESC: Plan selection, invoice history, and payment methods belong in this account center so billing remains low-frequency and out of the workspace shell.
ACCOUNT_BILLING_STATUS_DESC: Billing data is not wired to a dedicated API yet. This page is the stable product surface, and the missing backend integration remains explicit.
ACCOUNT_PAGE_USAGE_DESC: Track account-wide usage and plan consumption.
ACCOUNT_USAGE_TOTAL_WORKSPACES_DESC: Every workspace in this account contributes to the aggregate usage picture shown here.
ACCOUNT_USAGE_ADMIN_WORKSPACES_DESC: This counts workspaces where you currently act as the creator admin.
ACCOUNT_USAGE_STATUS_DESC: Detailed usage meters are not connected in this build yet. Until that API exists, workspace counts remain the only live account-level signal.
ACCOUNT_DANGER_ACCOUNT_DESC: Leaving and deleting an organization are no longer separate frontend flows. This page is reserved for irreversible actions tied to your account identity.
ACCOUNT_DANGER_WORKSPACE_TITLE: Workspace exits stay in workspace settings
ACCOUNT_DANGER_WORKSPACE_DESC: If a destructive action belongs to one workspace, it should live in that workspace's own settings and permissions boundary.
ME_DESC: Manage your profile, preferences, and security settings.
ME_TAB_PROFILE_DESC: Manage your personal details and connected accounts.
ME_TAB_PREFERENCES_DESC: Customize interface appearance, localization, and accessibility.
ME_TAB_SECURITY_DESC: Manage your password, sign-in methods, and active sessions.
ME_TAB_NOTIFICATIONS_DESC: Choose how you receive notifications and updates.

ME_PROFILE_PASSWORD_2FA_MUTUALLY_EXCLUSI: Use either the verification code or the backup code, not both
ME_PROFILE_PASSWORD_DESC_CHANGE: Change your current password to keep your account secure.

ME_LINKED_ACCOUNTS_DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect this provider? You might lose access if no other sign-in methods are configured.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_DESC: Deleting your account is permanent. All data will be wiped immediately and cannot be recovered.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_ALERT_DESC: Account deletion removes your access permanently. Personal details will be anonymized, though some audit logs may remain.
ME_DELETE_ACCOUNT_CONFIRM_EMAIL_INVALID: Please enter a valid email address
ME_PREF_NOTIFICATIONS_PANEL_PIN_DESC: Keep the panel pinned when opened.
ME_PREF_NAV_BADGE_DESC: Display unread count badge for the notifications menu item in the sidebar.
ME_PREF_CONTRAST_DESC: Increase contrast between text, borders, and backgrounds.
ME_PREF_TEXT_SIZE_DESC: Adjust the interface text size. This only affects typography, not layout spacing.
ME_PREF_TEXT_SIZE_ALERT_DESC: Large text may cause layout truncation.
ME_PREF_TEXT_WEIGHT_ALERT_DESC: Extreme font weights may reduce readability.
ME_PREF_TIMEZONE_DESC: Leave default to follow workspace or browser timezone.
ME_PREF_TIMEZONE_AUTO_SWITCH_DESC: When enabled, the detected browser timezone is used and manual timezone selection is disabled.
ME_PREF_LANGUAGE_BROWSER_SWITCH_DESC: When enabled, the browser language is used and manual language selection is disabled.
ME_SECURITY_CHANGE_PASSWORD_DIALOG_DESC: Enter your current password and set a new one.
ME_SECURITY_PASSWORD_CHANGE_FAILED: Update failed. Check your current password.
ME_SECURITY_2FA_DISABLED_DESC: Use an authenticator app to generate one-time codes and add an extra layer of account protection.
ME_SECURITY_2FA_AUTH_APP_DESC: Use an app like 1Password or Google Authenticator to generate one-time codes.
ME_SECURITY_SIGNIN_DISABLED_DESC: Sign-in method management is not available yet.
ME_NOTIFY_PANEL_DESC: Choose event delivery by channel. Preferences are stored on server and applied per account.
ME_NOTIFY_CHANNEL_IN_APP_DESC: In-app notifications are listed in the Inbox entry under the left sidebar navigation.
ME_NOTIFY_EMAIL_PANEL_DESC: Email notifications are sent to your account email address when each event supports email delivery.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_GENERIC_DESC: Configure how this event should notify you.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_INVITATION_ACC: Notify me when someone accepts an invitation that I issued.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_INVITE_CREATED: Notify me when a workspace email invite is created for my account.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_INVITE_UPDATED: Notify me when an existing workspace email invite for me is updated.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_INVITE_RENEWED: Notify me when a workspace email invite for me is renewed.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_INVITE_REVOKED: Notify me when a workspace email invite for me is revoked.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_STATUS_: Notify me when my workspace membership is enabled or disabled.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ROLES_U: Notify me when my assigned workspace roles change.
ME_NOTIFY_TOPIC_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_PASSWOR: Notify me when my workspace password is reset by an admin.

ME_SECURITY_2FA_SETUP_SECRET_HELP: If you cannot scan the QR code, enter this key manually in your authenticator app.
ME_SECURITY_2FA_BACKUP_CODES_DESC: These codes are shown only once. Copy them to a safe place now.

ME_SECURITY_2FA_REAUTH_MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIV: Use either the verification code or the backup code, not both
ME_SECURITY_SESSIONS_REVOKE_NOTE: Revoking a session immediately stops refresh token rotation. Existing access tokens may still expire naturally after a short grace period.
